Location: Italy
Description:

A rotational Chief Stewardess is sought for a 60m+ motor yacht operating in Italy. The position offers a salary up to €7000 DOE, a 2:2 rotation, medical insurance, and charter tips. Essential qualifications include STCW, ENG1, Food Hygiene Level 2, and a B1/2 visa. Candidates require 4-5 years of yachting experience, including charter work on similar-sized vessels, extensive silver service skills, and proven leadership abilities for the interior team. Longevity in previous roles is also necessary.
